title: Maximize One MEX
statement: Given a permutation of 0..n-1 (n ≤ 100), one swap may be made to maximize the k-th largest prefix MEX, printing -1 if none helps. Prefix MEX is non-decreasing, so this is the MEX of the first n-k+1 elements. The optimal swap moves the smallest missing value into that prefix, swapping out any element of value at least n-k+1; with n this small, trying every swap also passes.
